pullRequests.title: Docs: durable audited handoff before chat deletion
pullRequests.head: docs/chat-handoff-2026-09-19
pullRequests.body:
## User-authorized preservation
The user requested a whole-code review and transfer of useful current chat context to GitHub so work can resume after deleting the conversation.

This PR changes **documentation only**. It does NOT merge Alpha 6 runtime, mark PR #13 ready, or close desktop acceptance.

## Included
- Root AGENTS.md and updated canonical PROJECT_HANDOFF.
- User-approved product direction, with fictional teen UX walkthrough and monetization assumptions labeled as hypotheses.
- Code-review findings backed by Source Audit run 35439904375: existing 48 tests / 46 JS syntax files / 29 pack refs passed; 4 targeted controls passed and 18 desired-behavior assertions failed on all three runners.
- Reproductions preserved separately in draft audit PR #14; runtime remains unchanged.
- Actual acceptance status: only earlier macOS damaged-app warning was physically reported; no user-supplied native PASS results.
- Head/base/synthetic merge build provenance and finite artifact retention.
- Working art versus unarchived editable/chat-only reference limitations.
- Original handoff, previous README and additive Alpha 6 plan archived verbatim.

## Verification
The diff must contain only AGENTS.md, README.md and docs/**. Do not merge experimental code merely to preserve context. Read the handoff and audit before future feature work.

pullRequests.title: Alpha 6 stabilization: behavior and display surfaces
pullRequests.head: alpha-6-stabilization-behavior-surfaces
pullRequests.body:
Second stabilization slice on top of PR #17. No new product features.

Fixes:
- A12 Memory Echo now derives relationship history from raw store state instead of requiring a pre-derived state.relationship.
- A13 Rig applies attentionScale to eye/head/body movement, so Quiet/Focus actually reduce motion.
- A14 Surface eligibility rejects horizontally off-screen host windows.
- A15 Locomotion now stages run → jump → landing instead of immediately overriding jump with run; reduced-motion skips the travel animation and overlapping moves are generation-cancelled.
- A16 Runtime listens for display removed/metrics changed/added and relocates a stranded companion onto an available work area.

Also fixes Memory Echo cooldown under clock rollback and adds pure display-recovery geometry.

Added regressions for all of the above. Keep draft until CI passes and native multi-monitor/locomotion behavior is physically tested.

pullRequests.title: Alpha 6 stabilization: foundation contracts
pullRequests.head: alpha-6-stabilization-foundations
pullRequests.body:
Third stabilization slice on top of PR #18. No user-facing features.

Fixes:
- A10 Character Pack SDK now rejects parent-only, traversal, POSIX absolute, Windows drive/UNC, URL-scheme and control-character asset paths.
- A11 publicCharacterDescriptor handles omitted optional capabilities consistently with validation.
- A17 bounded local text reader marks truncation when the 80k character cap is hit, not only when the byte-read cap is hit.
- A18 revocation merge chooses a deterministic canonical representation for equivalent records with competing signature fields; signed beats unsigned, otherwise lexical signature order provides convergence.

Added behavior-level regressions for all four findings.

Note: A18 is deterministic convergence only. It does not add cryptographic signature verification; that remains future platform security work.
